# the registry settings as a hosts directory (hosts.toml), found through config_path of the CRI image service; config_path is set in the template
H=/var/lib/bench66642654/common/hosts.d
sudo mkdir -p "$H/10.66.64.45:32000"
printf 'server = "http://10.66.64.45:32000"\n\n[host."http://10.66.64.45:32000"]\n  capabilities = ["pull", "resolve"]\n' | sudo tee "$H/10.66.64.45:32000/hosts.toml" >/dev/null
sudo sed -i "/registry\]/,/config_path/ s|config_path = ''|config_path = '$H'|" /var/lib/bench66642654/current/args/containerd-template.toml
sudo /var/lib/bench66642654/bin/mk8sctl restart

# the question's own try: edit containerd.toml, restart the node
sudo tee -a /var/lib/bench66642654/current/args/containerd.toml >/dev/null <<'TOML'

[plugins.'io.containerd.cri.v1.images'.registry.mirrors.'10.66.64.45:32000']
  endpoint = ['http://10.66.64.45:32000']
TOML
sudo /var/lib/bench66642654/bin/mk8sctl restart

# the right file, but containerd reads its configuration only when it starts
sudo tee -a /var/lib/bench66642654/current/args/containerd-template.toml >/dev/null <<'TOML'

[plugins.'io.containerd.cri.v1.images'.registry.mirrors.'10.66.64.45:32000']
  endpoint = ['http://10.66.64.45:32000']
TOML

# the snippet of the question (the CRI plugin of containerd 1.x) in the template: a containerd 2.x configuration reads the registry table under io.containerd.cri.v1.images
sudo tee -a /var/lib/bench66642654/current/args/containerd-template.toml >/dev/null <<'TOML'

[plugins.cri.registry]
  [plugins.cri.registry.mirrors]
    [plugins.cri.registry.mirrors."10.66.64.45:32000"]
      endpoint = ["http://10.66.64.45:32000"]
    [plugins.cri.registry.configs."10.66.64.45:32000".tls]
      insecure_skip_verify = true
TOML
sudo /var/lib/bench66642654/bin/mk8sctl restart

# ctr takes --plain-http per call and puts the image into the node: the check removes it and pulls a new build
sudo ctr -a /var/lib/bench66642654/common/run/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images pull --plain-http 10.66.64.45:32000/myapp:latest

sudo /var/lib/bench66642654/bin/mk8sctl stop
sudo tee -a /var/lib/bench66642654/current/args/containerd.toml >/dev/null <<'TOML'

[plugins.'io.containerd.cri.v1.images'.registry.mirrors.'10.66.64.45:32000']
  endpoint = ['http://10.66.64.45:32000']
TOML
sudo env -i PATH="$PATH" setsid -f containerd --config /var/lib/bench66642654/current/args/containerd.toml >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null
sleep 3

# the entry is appended to the generated file by the launcher itself (the template stays as it is)
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
p = '/var/lib/bench66642654/bin/mk8s-run-containerd'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace('echo $$ >', 'printf "\\n[plugins.\'io.containerd.cri.v1.images\'.registry.mirrors.\'10.66.64.45:32000\']\\n  endpoint = [\'http://10.66.64.45:32000\']\\n" >> "$ARGS/containerd.toml"\necho $$ >', 1)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
PY
sudo /var/lib/bench66642654/bin/mk8sctl restart
